page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top, with the page number at top right. Main text in one column, with the date line, a division heading, a title, a salutation and the first body paragraph. Catchword at right and signature at left below the last line.

main_text.p: bes, Vir illustris, & mihi plurimum ob-servande Domine, retardationis meæ sin-ceras excusationes, jam nihil aliud quæro, quàm codicis tui remittendi occasio-nem, illum brevi Deo dante recuperabis integrum, Capitum & Versuum perpetua adnotatione auctum, Vale, & me tui observantissimum ut amare pergas, etiam atque etiam rogo.
main_text.head: EPIST. LII.
Pet. à Valle J. Morino ad præcedentem Responsio.
main_text.p: Admodum Reverendo Patri, atque Eruditissimo Domino suo Patri Joanni Morino, Congregat. Orator. Presbytero, Petrus à Valle Peregrinus S. P. D.

EXimia me jucunditate perfuderunt, amantissime mi Pater, atque observantissime Domine, litteræ tuæ, quas Cajetæ accepi. Verè namque anxius e-ram, non quidem de restitutione Penta-teuchi mei: De hac enim ante annum

page.notes: Printed text is clear throughout. The initial E of "EXimia" is a large letter joined to the next word. The "De" before "hac" carries a mark under the D that may be a cedilla; read as "De". The signature "S 7" and catchword "ad te" are as printed at the foot.
